limitations: Experimental, rule-based road-condition risk index; not an accident probability.
Risk-score anchors and weights are design assumptions, not calibrated against safety outcomes.
PPE reflects historical road roughness; not direct defect or crash severity.
STRIDE Random Forest baseline showed limited test performance; verify predictions.
YOLO confidence is not defect depth, physical severity, or accident risk.
Daily rainfall is contextual; it does not confirm standing water or surface friction.
DEMO ONLY: input combination is synthetic, not observed or validated.
Real YOLO predictions are from an RDD image; roughness, IMU and weather are synthetic and deliberately NOT paired with that image.
